summary: Iteration 2: illustration reveal/lock feature (Pollinations.ai) end-to-end verified. Backend: 25/25 pytest passing (added 6 illustration tests + refactored free-tier tests to use a proper free user since tester1 was upgraded to premium). Frontend: full premium + full free-tier flows both green. Premium (tester1@fantm.ink) reader shows real cover on sidebar (data-testid=reader-cover-image) and real per-chapter illustration on each chapter (data-testid=reader-illustration-image), both hitting image.pollinations.ai/prompt/... URLs; dashboard shows real cover thumbnail (data-testid=book-cover-{id}); PDF export returns HTTP 200 application/pdf. Free tier (fresh user + 1 book) shows 'cover locked' on dashboard card (data-testid=book-cover-locked-{id}), 'cover locked' in reader sidebar (data-testid=reader-cover-locked), and 'illustration locked — upgrade to reveal' in reader body (data-testid=reader-illustration-locked). All three lock targets open the UpgradeModal when clicked. Regressions verified: free tier still cannot edit chapters (opens UpgradeModal), cannot export PDF (opens UpgradeModal), cannot create a 2nd book (opens UpgradeModal, backend still 403). No 'illustration coming soon' placeholder ever shown once has_image=True — matches spec.

minor.issue: Invalid lookup_key still returns HTTP 500 with 'Price not found' (should be 400) — carried over from iteration 1, not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: books.py serialize_book/serialize_chapter correctly gate cover_image_url and image_url behind reveal_images while keeping has_cover_image/has_image booleans exposed. Clean, consistent tier gating.

generation.py URL construction is deterministic (sha256 seed per book + chapter offset) so images are stable across regenerations of the page — good for caching. STYLE_SUFFIX enforces consistent gothic aesthetic.

pdf_export.py fetches Pollinations images via requests.get inside build_book_pdf and embeds them — could add a timeout/fallback to avoid the endpoint hanging (currently blocks up to ~60s for the 5-chapter book, borderline OK).
BookReader.jsx: the 3-way branch (image_url present → real image, else has_image && !isPremium → locked button, else → 'illustration generating...' placeholder) is correct and unambiguous.
BookCard.jsx: dashboard shows locked placeholder for free tier when has_cover_image=true — spec-compliant.

Free-tier user with a completed book that has has_cover_image but null cover_image_url renders correctly, but note: the reader-cover-locked button lacks a visible tooltip/aria-label — minor a11y nit only.
generation.py's `client = Groq(api_key=os.environ["GROQ_API_KEY"])` at module import time will crash server startup if the env var is unset. Safe for now (var is set), but noted.

TestIllustrations covers premium reveal + free-tier lock (creates a fresh user + book and polls up to 60s for cover to appear).
